title: The built-in Counter Sale customer can go on a tier, with a tooltip
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, named Counter Sale by the client.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open the built-in Counter Sale customer's page.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  3. Point at the Work Order Tier field.
  4. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  5. Pick tier A.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  8. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  9. Point at the Work Order Tier field.
  10. Click Cancel.
  11. Open the built-in Counter Sale customer's page.
  12. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  13. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  14. Pick 1 · Default.
  15. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The built-in Counter Sale customer's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer shows Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "Every walk-in sale uses this tier."

Step 4:

  • The picker lists tier A.

Step 5:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier A.

Step 6:

  • The card shows Work Order Tier as tier A.

Step 7:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 8:

  • Edit Customer shows the tier fields.

Step 9:

  • No "Every walk-in sale uses this tier." tooltip shows.
  • The Work Order Tier field shows as on any customer.

Step 10:

  • Edit Customer closes.

Step 11:

  • The built-in Counter Sale customer's page opens.

Step 12:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 13:

  • The picker lists 1 · Default.

Step 14:

  • Work Order Tier reads 1 · Default.

Step 15:

  • The card shows Work Order Tier 1 · Default again.
